name: Walking Deli Sandwich (in a Chip Bag)
desc: A chopped Italian deli salad with a creamy red wine vinegar dressing, tossed with salt and vinegar kettle chips and eaten out of the bag.

source.title: Walking Deli Sandwich
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 (8 oz) bag salt and vinegar kettle-cooked potato chips
ingredients.item: salt and vinegar kettle-cooked potato chips

ingredients.raw: 3 cups chopped romaine lettuce (or regular lettuce)
1/4 cup banana pepper rings (or pepperoncini), chopped
1/4 cup pitted green or black olives, chopped
1 tsp olive brine (from the olive jar)
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Chop the salami, prosciutto, provolone, banana peppers and olives into bite-size pieces.
Whisk the mayonnaise, red wine vinegar, olive brine and a pinch each of salt and pepper in a small bowl.
In a large bowl, combine the romaine, chopped meats, provolone, banana peppers, olives, Parmesan and dressing. Toss until everything is coated.
Carefully open the chip bag along the top seam (or cut straight across the top) so it can work as a bowl. Lightly crush the chips inside the bag.
Tip the chips into the salad and toss again.
Spoon everything back into the chip bag and eat right away with a fork, before the chips soften.
tips: The deli version of walking tacos.
The reel gives no amounts. The meat, cheese and dressing quantities here are scaled from published chopped Italian sandwich recipes for two servings.
